TOPIC2.6
Derivative Rules: Constant,
Sum, Difference, and
Constant Multiple
LEARNINGOBJECTIVE
FUN-3.A
Calculate derivatives of
familiar functions.
ESSENTIALKNOWLEDGE
FUN-3.A.2
Sums, differences, and constant multiples
of functions can be differentiated using
derivative rules.
FUN-3.A.3
The power rule combined with sum, difference,
and constant multiple properties can be used to
find the derivatives for polynomial functions.
ENDURINGUNDERSTANDING
FUN-3
Recognizing opportunities to apply derivative rules can simplify differentiation.
